For the residues with missing peaks in the RelaxDB set, does the 2011 paper attribute them to exchange broadening, overlap, or solvent exchange?
protein_summary.buffer_note: Both SilB papers (10.1021/bi200005k and 10.1021/acs.biochem.6b00022) are closed access here and were read as abstracts only (C-priority rows), so every judgment is capped at indirect evidence. Sample conditions for the apo relaxation data come from the 2L55 deposition metadata (298 K, pH 6.0, 50 mM MES, 1 mM U-15N protein, 90% H2O/10% D2O), not from the article; metal-bound and apo samples, and the separate N-terminal constructs of the 2016 paper, are different sample states and are not combined. No oligomeric state is reported in the evidence rows; the deposition contains one chain.
